name: web/Open redirect cross-origin Location
description: [basic] Cross-origin open redirect in a next/redirect parameter (CWE-601; PortSwigger open-redirection): protocol-relative '//attacker' lands in the Location header — a 302 to the attacker origin is the proof. Keywords: open redirect next url redirect location cross-origin phishing oauth. ctrl: benign internal next stays same-origin -> not falsified. base_url = redirect-taking endpoint.
